platform: STM32F103xB / bxCAN Classic CAN / STM32F10x SPL
scope_note: Register/event semantics are tied to bxCAN. Code examples require board, startup-vector and interrupt integration review.

claims.claim: bxCAN has FIFO0 and FIFO1 with three receive mailboxes each
RFLM=0 overwrites last FIFO entry; RFLM=1 drops new incoming frame when full
FMP counts pending receive frames, FOVR marks overflow
Standard 11-bit ID maps to filter high-half bits 15..5
